name: Mattel
description_short: Mattel is a federally-insured credit union based in El Segundo, CA. Member-owned and not-for-profit, it provides everyday banking, lending, and savings services to its membership.
description_long: Mattel is a federal credit union serving members in , , established in 1952. As a not-for-profit financial cooperative, credit unions typically offer lower loan rates, higher savings rates, and fewer fees than traditional banks. The credit union operates 4 branch locations. Deposits are federally insured up to $250,000 by the National Credit Union Administration (NCUA).
